title: MeshChat JSON control WebSocket messages
description: Wire payload schemas derived from the pinned source. Use $defs/ClientMessage or $defs/ServerMessage for direction-specific validation. Binary audio is intentionally not a JSON payload; see protocol specification. Extra keys are tolerated as the upstream dispatcher does.

HexHash.description: Hexadecimal hash. Application serializers emit lowercase. No hash-length check is imposed by MeshChat itself; bytes.fromhex() accepts more than this normal client form.

Base64Bytes.description: Standard base64 text, not a data: URL.

DatabaseTimestamp.description: SQLite/Peewee UTC datetime string, commonly YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.ffffff+00:00. Not declared format:date-time because the source does not guarantee RFC 3339 syntax.

is_transport_enabled.description: Active runtime state, not necessarily the pending on-disk setting.

auto_announce_enabled.description: Derived when setting the interval; not writable directly through update_config.

auto_announce_interval_seconds.description: Positive enables automatic announcing; zero or negative disables it.

last_announced_at.description: Unix seconds. Null before first announce.

theme.description: No enum validation in the server. Frontend uses light/dark.

lxmf_preferred_propagation_node_destinat.description: Configured propagation destination. Null/empty disables the active node. Invalid values may remain stored while active selection is cleared.

display_name.description: Empty string is ignored; null clears the stored entry and restores its default.

theme.description: Empty string is ignored; null clears the stored entry and restores its default.

auto_announce_interval_seconds.description: Coerced using Python int(); there is no range validation. A malformed value raises an uncaught error.

lxmf_preferred_propagation_node_destinat.description: Configured propagation destination. Null/empty disables the active node. Invalid values may remain stored while active selection is cleared.

lxmf_preferred_propagation_node_auto_syn.description: Coerced using Python int(); there is no range validation. A malformed value raises an uncaught error.

ConfigPatch.description: Partial config update. Unknown keys, including read-only Config fields, are ignored. Boolean settings use Python bool(value); clients should send actual JSON booleans, not strings. Updates are sequential and not transactional. Broadcasts a full config event to all clients even for an empty update.

image_type.description: Image subtype passed to LXMF, e.g. png or jpg; no server whitelist.

audio_mode.description: LXMF audio mode number; passed through without a local enum check.

MessageFields.description: Named JSON fields, not numeric LXMF field IDs. Only these three are mapped by this API. Other input fields are ignored; other LXMF fields are omitted from message serialization. Icon appearance is derived from Config and exposed on peers/conversations instead.

is_incoming.description: For an incoming message, do not interpret outbound state as a delivery receipt.

progress.description: Percentage: round(LXMF progress * 100, 2). Normally 0..100; not clamped.

next_delivery_attempt_at.description: Unix seconds, or null if not yet set.

timestamp.description: LXMF creation timestamp as Unix seconds.

LiveLxmfMessage.description: Live LXMF object used in send responses, created events and state events. It deliberately has no database id/created_at/updated_at.

is_incoming.description: For an incoming message, do not interpret outbound state as a delivery receipt.

progress.description: Percentage: round(LXMF progress * 100, 2). Normally 0..100; not clamped.

next_delivery_attempt_at.description: Unix seconds, or null if not yet set.

timestamp.description: LXMF creation timestamp as Unix seconds.

StoredLxmfMessage.description: Database message used in conversation history, cancel response and lxmf.delivery events. method may be null in migrated rows.

delivery_method.description: direct, opportunistic or propagated are recognized. Missing, null or unrecognized strings use automatic selection. paper is not an explicit send option.

content.description: May be empty; attachment-only messages are supported.

SendMessageRequest.description: No title input is consumed. Missing nested required keys or invalid attachment payloads fail outside the send try/except, normally as HTTP 500. The schema describes normal client inputs, not all Python coercions.

aspect.description: Registered listeners: call.audio, lxmf.delivery, lxmf.propagation, nomadnetwork.node.

hops.description: Live hops_to() value; an unknown-path sentinel is possible.

display_name.description: Parsed for lxmf.delivery and nomadnetwork.node only; other aspects return null.

Conversation.description: Ordered by most recent message creation time, not progress-update time.

AudioCall.description: Calls are held in memory. Remote identity/destination/path may be null until known.

outbound_ticket_expiry.description: Unix expiry time from LXMF; no ticket material is exposed.

messages_received.description: Last transfer result, passed through from the installed LXMF version. Normally an integer count; MeshChat itself imposes no type or nullability guarantee.

per_transfer_limit.description: Value parsed from announcement entry [2]. Unit is not defined by MeshChat; do not silently assume bytes.

ifac_signature.description: Converted from nonempty bytes to hex.

hash.description: Converted from nonempty bytes to hex.

InterfaceStatsEntry.description: RNS get_interface_stats().interfaces entry. MeshChat only normalizes the fields listed here. All other keys and their availability belong to the installed RNS version; additionalProperties is intentional.

InterfaceStats.description: Dependency-owned pass-through object. requirements.txt specifies rns>=1.3.7, not one exact version. This source does not establish a closed, stable list of stats fields.

PathTableEntry.description: RNS get_path_table() entry. Only hash and via are normalized here; other keys pass through from the installed RNS version.

InterfaceConfig.description: Reticulum ConfigObj configuration. Values may be strings, lists or nested objects; no normalization to JSON numbers/booleans is performed. GET flattens RNodeMultiInterface child sections into sub_interfaces, each with name.

ImportedInterface.description: Parsed ConfigObj interface. Unlike GET interfaces, RNodeMultiInterface nested child sections remain named object properties.

RNodeSubInterface.description: At least one sub-interface is required for RNodeMultiInterface. All listed values must be present and neither null nor empty; numeric values are coerced with int().

devices.description: ConfigObj-compatible list or text; passed through.

ignored_devices.description: ConfigObj-compatible list or text; passed through.

peers.description: ConfigObj-compatible list or text; passed through.

type.description: Unknown type names are accepted and persisted; supported branches are listed in x-type-rules.

InterfaceWriteRequest.description: Create or replace interface configuration. This is not JSON Merge Patch: omitted optional fields handled by InterfaceEditor are removed. Existing name is rejected unless overwrite is allowed. A successful response writes configuration, but does not reload interfaces.

FavouriteWriteRequest.description: Only null/missing checks are applied, not nonempty/format checks. Upserts by destination hash, not by (destination hash, aspect).

Ping.description: Application JSON keepalive, distinct from WebSocket protocol ping frames.

SetConfig.description: Apply supported ConfigPatch keys. Produces a full config broadcast, not a correlated acknowledgement.

DownloadFile.description: Begin a NomadNet file request. Results are sent only to this socket.

page_path.description: May contain a backtick followed by key=value|key=value variables.

field_data.description: Required key. A JSON object supplies field_ prefixed form values; nonobjects/null are accepted but ignored.

DownloadPage.description: Begin a NomadNet page request. field_data is required by direct indexing even when no form values exist; send {}.

Pong.description: Reply to the initiating socket only; no timestamp or request ID.

ConfigEvent.description: Full configuration. Broadcast on every control connection, supported config update and propagation-sync start.

Announced.description: Local destinations were announced. No config body, destination list or timestamp is included.

IncomingAudioCall.description: Notification only. Fetch GET /api/v1/calls to discover call details.

AnnounceEvent.description: A registered-aspect announcement was stored. Other emitters use the same serialization.

LxmfDelivery.description: New incoming message after database persistence. Sideband telemetry-request commands are filtered and generate no delivery event.

LxmfMessageCreated.description: Outbound message created. No database id/timestamps are present. This event can precede the HTTP send response.

LxmfMessageStateUpdated.description: Full live message state, emitted by callbacks and a one-second progress loop. Not a patch and not guaranteed exactly once.

LxmfMessageDeleted.description: Sent only by failed-message automatic resend cleanup. Direct REST delete handlers do not emit this event.

progress.description: Raw RNS RequestReceipt progress, normally 0..1; unlike message/propagation progress, not a percentage.

NomadnetFileProgress.description: Request-local file progress response. Correlate by destination_hash and original file_path; there is no request ID.

NomadnetFileSuccess.description: Request-local file success response. Correlate by destination_hash and original file_path; there is no request ID.

failure_reason.description: Examples: Could not find path to destination.; Could not establish link to destination.; request_failed; unsupported_response (file). Not a closed enum.

NomadnetFileFailure.description: Request-local file failure response. Correlate by destination_hash and original file_path; there is no request ID.

progress.description: Raw RNS RequestReceipt progress, normally 0..1; unlike message/propagation progress, not a percentage.

NomadnetPageProgress.description: Request-local page progress response. Correlate by destination_hash and original page_path; there is no request ID.

NomadnetPageSuccess.description: Request-local page success response. Correlate by destination_hash and original page_path; there is no request ID.

failure_reason.description: Examples: Could not find path to destination.; Could not establish link to destination.; request_failed; unsupported_response (file). Not a closed enum.

NomadnetPageFailure.description: Request-local page failure response. Correlate by destination_hash and original page_path; there is no request ID.
